channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Sacuudiga oo xilka ka qaaday taliyaha isbahaysiga Yemen, iyadoo Xuuthiyiintu u soo dhowaanayaan Cadan
item.description: Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, xilka ka qaaday taliyaha isbahaysiga ay hoggaamiso ee la dagaallamaya Xuuthiyiinta Yemen, xilli kooxdu ay u soo dhowaanayso magaalada Cadan, sida ay werisay France 24 iyadoo xigatay warbaahinta dowladda Sacuudiga.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz oo 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaaday Frances Tiafoe kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee ATP Finals
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, Frances Tiafoe kaga adkaaday 6-2, 6-2 saacad iyo sagaal daqiiqo gudahood, kulankiisii furitaanka ee ATP Finals, inkastoo uu jilibka midig ku xirnaa faashad, sida ay wariyeen AS iyo kicker.

item.title: Iran oo sheegtay inaysan u oggolaan doonin kormeerayaasha IAEA xarumaha nukliyeerka ilaa dagaalku dhammaado
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, sheegtay inay hor istaagi doonto in kormeerayaasha Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga ee Caalamka (IAEA) ay booqdaan xarumaheeda nukliyeerka ee waxyeelloobay, ilaa shuruudaha ay dhigtay ee dhammaadka dagaalka Mareykanku ka fuliyo.

item.title: SoDMA oo shirka COP31 ka sheegtay in isbeddelka cimiladu uu sii huriyo barakaca Soomaaliya
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Soomaaliyeed (SoDMA), Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa doodda IGAD ee shirka cimilada COP31 ku baaqay maalgelin joogto ah iyo iskaashi gobol iyo caalami si bulshooyinka Soomaaliyeed loogu xoojiyo u adkeysiga abaaraha iyo fatahaadaha.

item.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo Muqdisho ka furay shirweynaha 3-aad ee qaran ee dabagalka iyo qiimeynta
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, Muqdisho ka furay Shirweynaha Saddexaad ee Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimeynta (SNMEC 2026), isagoo ku baaqay in waxqabadka dowladda lagu cabbiro natiijooyin la taaban karo oo xog lagu caddeyn karo.

item.title: Safiirka Shiinaha: Shiinaha iyo Jabuuti waxay diidan yihiin aqoonsiga Somaliland
item.description: Safiirka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Wang Yu, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, sheegay in Shiinaha iyo Jabuuti ay taageerayaan midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, ayna ka soo horjeedaan dadaallada Somaliland ee aqoonsiga diblomaasiyadeed, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Aragti: Xil qaran iyo dhalasho labaad – yaa difaacaya sharafta Soomaaliya?
item.description: Qormadan aragtida ah waxay su’aal ka keenaysaa jawaabta Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, oo loo fasiran karo inuu ka gaabsaday inuu dhaliilo madaxweynaha Mareykanka, iyo masuuliyadda uu xilka qaran ku leeyahay difaaca karaamada shacabka.

item.title: Vinícius Júnior oo qiray in xiisihii Arsenal ee xagaagii uu saameeyay qaabka ciyaartiisa
item.description: Weeraryahanka Real Madrid, Vinícius Júnior, ayaa sheegay in warar kala iibsiga ee xagaagii, oo ay ugu weyneyd xiisaha Arsenal, ay maskaxdiisa ku jahwareeriyeen, taasoo qeyb ka ah bilowga liita ee xilli ciyaareedkan, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo Capital FM.

item.title: Madaxweynaha xiriirka Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, oo loo tixgelinayo inuu la tartamo Infantino
item.description: Madaxweynaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, ayaa soo baxay inuu noqon karo musharax ka soo horjeeda Gianni Infantino doorashada madaxtinimada FIFA ee March, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Cristian Chivu oo ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Panchina d'Oro ee tababaraha ugu fiican Serie A
item.description: Tababaraha Inter, Cristian Chivu, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Panchina d'Oro ee xilli ciyaareedkii 2025/26, oo ay tababarayaasha Talyaanigu siiyaan saaxiibkood ugu fiican, kaddib markii uu Inter u hooyay horyaalka Serie A iyo Coppa Italia.

item.title: Dowladda Turkiga oo dadaallo xooggan ka wadda xallinta khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya
item.description: Ankara oo adkaynaysa doorkeeda dhexdhexaadinta, iyadoo xoogga saaraysa wada-hadal loo dhan yahay iyo mustaqbal siyaasadeed oo xasilloon.

item.title: Romelu Lukaku oo ka fariistay xulka Belgium kadib 94 gool iyo 135 kulan
item.description: Weeraryahanka Romelu Lukaku, oo ah gooldhaliyaha ugu badan abid ee xulka ragga Belgium, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay ciyaaraha caalamiga ah kadib 16 sano.

item.title: Shan dal oo Yurub ah oo la filayo inay ku dhawaaqaan xarun lagu celiyo muhaajiriinta oo laga dhiso Kigali
item.description: Jarmalka, Denmark, Austria, Giriigga iyo Netherlands ayaa la filayaa inay ku dhawaaqaan in caasimadda Rwanda, Kigali, laga dhiso xarun loogu talagalay magangalyo-doonayaasha laga diiday sii joogitaanka Midowga Yurub, sida ay BBC u sheegeen ilo diblomaasiyadeed.

item.title: Puntland: Wasiirka Maaliyadda oo baarlamaanka ku qiray in shaqaalaha rayidka 6 bilood aan la mushaarin
item.description: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Puntland, Maxamed Faarax Maxamuud, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, baarlamaanka hortiisa ku qiray in shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee dowladda aysan mushaar qaadan muddo 6 bilood ah, isagoo sidoo kale golaha u gudbiyay miisaaniyadda 2027.

item.title: Markab dagaal oo saddexaad oo Mareykan ah oo gaaray Bariga Dhexe, Iran oo sheegtay inay u heellan tahay diblomaasiyadda
item.description: Markabka diyaaradaha sida ee USS Theodore Roosevelt ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, gaaray Bariga Dhexe, halka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, uu Islamabad ka sheegay in dalkiisu weli u heellan yahay diblomaasiyadda.

item.title: Maxkamad Hargeysa oo xabsi ku xukuntay siyaasi sheegay inuu u tartamayo madaxweynaha Soomaaliya iyo wariyihii waraystay
item.description: Maxkamadda Gobolka Maroodi-jeex ee Hargeysa ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, xabsi ku xukuntay siyaasiga Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Sharaay iyo wariye Cabdiraxmaan Cige, kadib waraysi uu Sharaay kaga hadlay damaciisa ah inuu u tartamo xilka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya.

item.title: Shiinaha: Xi, Trump iyo Putin oo Shenzhen kaga wada hadli doona nabadda adduunka
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Shiinaha ayaa Isniinta xaqiijisay in Madaxweyne Xi Jinping, Donald Trump iyo Vladimir Putin ay Khamiista, 19 November, magaalada Shenzhen ku yeelan doonaan shirkii ugu horreeyay ee saddex-geesood ah, iyagoo ka wada hadli doona nabadda adduunka iyo xasilloonida istiraatiijiga ah.

item.title: Ciidanka Asluubta oo fashiliyay maandooriye la doonayay in la geliyo Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho
item.description: Taliska Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed ayaa Isniinta sheegay inuu gacanta ku dhigay maandooriye la doonayay in si qarsoodi ah loo geliyo Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho, lix haween ahna lagu xiray, kaddib hawlgal laba bilood socday.

item.title: Mareykanka oo dib u cusboonaysiinaya taageerada xafiiska UNSOS iyo howlgalka AUSSOM
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa wakaaladda AFP u xaqiijisay in Washington ay hal sano oo kale taageeri doonto kordhinta waajibaadka Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS) iyo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Ruushka oo sheegay inuu habeennimo riday 1,336 drone oo Ukraine ah; buundada Crimea la weeraray
item.description: Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa Isniinta sheegtay in difaaceeda cirku uu habeennimadii riday 1,336 diyaaradood oo drone ah oo Ukraine soo dirtay, kuwaas oo boqolaal ka mid ahi u socdeen Moscow, halka maamulaha Crimea uu sheegay in buundada Crimea la weeraray.

item.title: Warbixin gaar ah: Waxqabadka iyo hoggaaminta xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre
item.description: Warbixin gaar ah oo ku saabsan waxqabadka xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre: dowlad-dhis, horumar, amni, diblomaasiyad iyo dowlad-wanaag.

item.title: Suudaan iyo Itoobiya oo isku eedeynaya taageerada kooxaha hubeysan
item.description: Xiisadda u dhexaysa Suudaan iyo Itoobiya ayaa sii korortay, iyadoo dal waliba uu kan kale ku eedeynayo inuu taageero kooxo hubeysan oo dagaal ka wada gudaha xuduudihiisa, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.

item.title: Kenya oo baaritaan ku billowday boob lagu qaaday xafiisyada qaxootiga ee Hagadera, Dadaab
item.description: Dowladda Kenya ayaa ku baaqday degganaansho deegaanka Hagadera ee Dadaab, kadib markii xafiisyada Waaxda Adeegyada Qaxootiga la burburiyay oo la boobay, iyadoo ay ku eedaysan yihiin koox dhallinyaro qaxooti ah, sida ay werisay Capital FM Kenya.

item.title: Ciidamada Uganda ee AUSSOM oo Xoogga Dalka ku wareejiyay shan saldhig oo ku yaalla Baraawe
item.description: Ciidamada Uganda ee ka tirsan hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ku wareejiyay shan saldhig oo ku yaalla aagga Baraawe ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Martine Moïse, carmalladii madaxweyne Jovenel Moïse, oo isu diiwaangelisay musharax madaxweyne Haiti
item.description: Martine Moïse, oo ah carmalladii madaxweynihii hore ee Haiti Jovenel Moïse oo la dilay sannadkii 2021, ayaa isu diiwaangelisay musharax madaxweyne doorashada sannadka soo socda, sida ay werisay BBC News.

item.title: 49ers oo 46-40 kaga adkaaday Cowboys, natiijo aan weligeed horay uga dhicin taariikhda NFL
item.description: San Francisco 49ers ayaa Axaddii 15 November magaalada Dallas ku garaacay Dallas Cowboys 46-40, ciyaar 86 dhibcood leh oo natiijadeedu ay markii ugu horreysay abid ka dhacday horyaalka kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee NFL.

item.title: Toronto Tempo oo ku guuleystay bakhtiyaanasiibka WNBA, waxayna heleen doorashada 1-aad ee 2027
item.description: Kooxda cusub ee Toronto Tempo ayaa Axaddii 15 November ku guuleysatay bakhtiyaanasiibka doorashada ciyaartoyda WNBA, waxayna heshay doorashada 1-aad ee 2027, taasoo fursad u siin karta inay qaataan xiddigta USC JuJu Watkins.

item.title: Sarkaal ciidanka Mareykanka ah oo cabasho ka gudbiyay Pentagon-ka weerarkii Iran ee ku dilay 6 askari Kuwait
item.description: Sarkaal ka tirsan ciidanka dhulka Mareykanka oo ka badbaaday weerar diyaarad drone ah oo Iran ku qaadday xarun Mareykan oo ku taal Kuwait, kaas oo dilay 6 askari, ayaa Congress-ka u gudbiyay cabasho uu ku sheegay in hoggaanka ciidamadu iska indha tireen walaacii laga qabay difaaca xarunta.

item.title: Mirra Andreeva oo finalka kaga adkaatay Svitolina, ku guuleysatayna WTA Finals
item.description: Ciyaartoyda Ruushka ah ee Mirra Andreeva, oo 19 jir ah, ayaa Axaddii 15 November finalka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells kaga adkaatay Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine 7-5, 6-3, waxayna noqotay ciyaartoyda ugu da'da yar ee ku guuleysata tartankan muddo 22 sano ah.

item.title: Amiir Harry oo booqasho lama filaan ah ku tegay Lviv, dagaalyahannada dhaawacmayna ku tilmaamay tusaale
item.description: Amiirka Ingiriiska Harry ayaa Axaddii 15 November soo gabagabeeyay booqasho aan horay loo shaacin oo uu ku tegay magaalada Lviv ee galbeedka Ukraine, halkaas oo uu ku ammaanay askarta dagaalka ku dhaawacantay, isagoo ku tilmaamay tusaalayaasha bulshada, sida ay werisay wakaaladda AP.
